name: Sparse Page Table and Brick Pool
aliases: Sparse Page Table and Brick Pool Volume Rendering
definition: A sparse volume representation that avoids materializing a dense 3D grid by using a two-level structure: a page table mapping logical 8³-texel regions to resident bricks, and a pool of apron-padded bricks. This allows full source resolution (up to 2048 cells per axis) while bounding memory usage and enabling empty-space skipping.
